chapters.text: Deleted leads stay in the Trash for 30 days with all their history and can be put back.
Deleting a lead (on the lead, or ticking several in the list) moves it to the Trash.
Open it from the gear button on the Leads page → Trash (deleted leads).
Each row shows the lead ID, phone, responsible person, how many activities, who deleted it and the days left. Search by name, phone or lead ID.
Press Restore on a row, or tick several and Restore selected: the lead comes back with the same ID, stage, responsible person and history, and its deals are linked again.
After 30 days it's removed for good. Super Admins can also Delete selected for good earlier.
